title: Graph coordinates and the projection onto the rotated plane
statement: For all n, l and every linear isometry q of R^(n+l): (i) graphPoint a b - graphPoint a' b' = graphPoint (a - a') (b - b') for a, a' in R^n, b, b' in R^l; (ii) |graphPoint a b|^2 = |a|^2 + |b|^2; (iii) every z in R^(n+l) equals graphPoint a b for some a in R^n, b in R^l; (iv) the orthogonal projection P onto T_0 = rotatedPlane q = q(R^n x {0}) satisfies P(q(graphPoint a b)) = q(graphPoint a 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ), (∀ (a a' : Rn n) (b b' : Rn ℓ), graphPoint a b - graphPoint a' b' = graphPoint (a - a') (b - b')) ∧ (∀ (a : Rn n) (b : Rn ℓ), ‖graphPoint a b‖ ^ 2 = ‖a‖ ^ 2 + ‖b‖ ^ 2) ∧ (∀ z : Amb n ℓ, ∃ (a : Rn n) (b : Rn ℓ), z = graphPoint a b) ∧ (∀ (a : Rn n) (b : Rn ℓ), (rotatedPlane q).starProjection (q (graphPoint a b)) = q (graphPoint a 0))
